title: Banquets, weddings and few dances; no place for Dixieland now
summary: Small halls hosted banquets and weddings rather than balls; today Dixieland bands play in the country, such as a Shell Beach job with Doc.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did they have many dances there in the old days? I never knew many dances in my time.
Oh yeah, yeah, plenty of balls there.

Yeah, different, but that ball never did take much, because the copyright is in the Hoops Hall, they used to call it. The Hoops Hall, that was it.
